translation:
Yin and yang come and go up and down, all attaching to the inside and outside of the jaw. The arteries beside the Adam's apple are the Renying point; in the horizontal bone of the jaw is the Daying point; in the hollow of the horizontal bone in front of the face is the Quepen point; the three segments of the neck bone below the brain are Dazhui; the place opposite the armpit is the soft inner; between the two breasts is Danzhong. These several places are all necessarily traversed, and the straight bone of the jaw is especially most important. After the head and neck are clear, still rub the jaw, so as not to let it accumulate again.

Four: The Adam's apple is the general meeting place of the qi and blood of the lung system. The arteries beside it, the Renying point, are within the skin and membranes. Of the five viscera and six bowels communicating with the head and the four limbs, apart from the navel, this is the only place.
